key_insight: CORTEX adds structured, stage-by-stage reasoning traces to 3D chest CT questions so MLLMs can explain and verify their conclusions, not just answer them.
clinical_relevance: This could make chest CT AI outputs more transparent and easier for clinicians to audit against imaging evidence and patient context.
method: Built CORTEX on CT-RATE with 76,177 validated reasoning traces.
Organized each example into four diagnostic stages: task understanding, visual observation, diagnostic reasoning, and answer synthesis.
Used LLM generation plus stage-level filtering with rubric scoring and expert radiologist review.
evidence_signal: The benchmark spans open-ended VQA, closed-ended VQA, and report generation, and pairs structured supervision with a stage-level evaluation protocol.
watch_item: Synthetic reasoning traces and rubric-based validation may not fully capture real-world radiology reasoning or generalize across institutions and scanners.
paper_title: CORTEX: A Structured Reasoning Benchmark for Trustworthy 3D Chest CT MLLMs
